context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS Ramelteon tablets, 8 mg are available as pale orange-yellow, round, film-coated tablets, debossed with “R” on one side and “8” on the other.

2. DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 2.1 Dosage in Adults The recommended dose of ramelteon tablets is 8 mg taken within 30 minutes of going to bed. It is recommended that ramelteon tablets not be taken with or immediately after a high-fat meal. T
